description: Change a draft: its title and/or REPLACE all its scenes (1-12, each with scriptText and optional visualPrompt / durationSeconds). The narration you send is exactly what is spoken. To change one scene use revise_scene. Edits are screened like any prompt. Free; works only while the draft has not been rendered. Requires the "video:create" scope.

scenes.description: The complete new scene list (replaces the old one).

scriptText.description: The narration of this scene, exactly as it will be spoken.

visualPrompt.description: What the image should show. Leave empty to let StoryShort write it at render.

name: update_draft
title: Update a draft
